+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu-aa/lp2169887-apparmor-treat-ROM-loaders-as-read-only.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+Description: apparmor: treat ROM loaders as read-only
+
+ROM loaders are always read-only, even when the domain XML omits the
+readonly attribute. Generate read-only AppArmor permissions for ROM
+firmware so restricted firmware paths are accepted.
+
+Author: Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>
+Forwarded: no
+Forward-info: already fixed in upstream master in this commit alongside
+ other changes:
+ https://github.com/libvirt/libvirt/commit/bcbb2667e206340702ce6ec7a5e862f771a11f9d
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+bug/2169887
+---
+ src/security/virt-aa-helper.c | 2 ++
+ 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)
+
+diff --git a/src/security/virt-aa-helper.c b/src/security/virt-aa-helper.c
+index de0a826063..e39a21731c 100644
+--- a/src/security/virt-aa-helper.c
++++ b/src/security/virt-aa-helper.c
+@@ -1021,6 +1021,8 @@ get_files(vahControl * ctl)
+     if (ctl->def->os.loader && ctl->def->os.loader->path) {
+         bool readonly = false;
+         virTristateBoolToBool(ctl->def->os.loader->readonly, &readonly);
++        if (ctl->def->os.loader->type == VIR_DOMAIN_LOADER_TYPE_ROM)
++            readonly = true;
+         if (vah_add_file(&buf,
+                          ctl->def->os.loader->path,
+                          readonly ? "rk" : "rwk") != 0) {
+-- 
+2.43.0
